tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind the app frame. Never put text directly on it except the page footer.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The app frame, sub-nav column and main content area.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Table cards, stat cards, inputs and outline buttons. Separated from `surface` by `border`, not by shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header row and the footer of a table card.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Active sub-nav item and the current breadcrumb crumb. Text on it is `ink` or `primary`.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The left icon rail — the system's signature navy field. Only nav rail items sit on it.

tokens.name: rail-ink
tokens.usage: Inactive rail icons and labels on `rail` (7.9:1 light, 10.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: rail-active
tokens.usage: The tile behind the current rail item.

tokens.name: rail-active-ink
tokens.usage: Icon and label of the current rail item, on `rail-active`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, table cell values, nav labels. On `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `surface-selected` in both themes (≥12:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: breadcrumb crumbs, 'Updated …' meta lines, button labels on outline buttons. ≥7:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Table column headers, placeholders, captions, the user's email. 4.7:1 on `surface-sunken` light; use at 12px+ only.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table row dividers, card outlines, the sub-nav column edge. Decorative only — never the sole cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline buttons, filter chips and pagination buttons (their label carries the meaning).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Text inputs and the search field, whose edge is the only cue (≥3.3:1 on `surface-raised` in both themes).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the 'Update' action pill, links, active icons, focus ring. As text on `surface` 13.7:1 light, 6.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of `primary` buttons.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a `primary` fill (13.7:1 light, 6.7:1 dark — dark theme flips to navy text on the lightened fill).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Keystone yellow: the logo tile at the top of the rail and the single highlight per screen (a new-record dot, the chart's lead series). Never text on white.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Monogram and any text on an `accent` fill (≥11:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint fill of a highlighted stat card. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: fresh
tokens.usage: The 'Updated' pill fill — a record that is current. Text on it is `on-fresh`.

tokens.name: on-fresh
tokens.usage: Label on a `fresh` fill (5.9:1). The reference shot used white here (≈2:1); Keystone uses deep teal to pass AA.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive deltas and 'Done' text, always beside a ▲ glyph or word. 5.4:1 light, 10.8:1 dark on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending / due-soon text, always with a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive confirmations, negative deltas (with ▼). Differs from `success` in lightness and always carries a glyph or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges and the count bubble on notifications.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series, after `primary`. From the Parrot periwinkle.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series. From the Parrot sage.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The greeting on a module's overview page. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title of a work list — names the stage the user is in.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: Product name in the header; the last word in `primary` weight 700.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Sub-nav items (may wrap to two lines).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines and secondary text in `ink-subtle` / `ink-muted`.

styles.name: rail
styles.usage: Labels under rail icons, in `rail-ink`. The only text below 12px.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The headline number on a stat card; tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside pills; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between action icons; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar controls; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; sub-nav item padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Table row vertical padding (gives the ~56px row).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between title and toolbar.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Main content gutter.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status pills, count badges, breadcrumb highlight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, inputs, rail tiles, sub-nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Table cards and stat cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The outer app frame on the canvas.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and notification dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, table card.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: The app frame floating on `canvas`. Nothing else casts a large shadow.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a solid `primary` ring offset by the surface.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The icon rail.

tokens.name: subnav-width
tokens.usage: The sub-nav column.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Primary toolbar buttons, chips and search.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Data table rows.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Line icons in tables, toolbar and header.
